files.description: Top-level orchestrator agent. Extends AbstractAgent. Registers all toolkits (FileSystemToolkit, ShellToolkit, MemoryToolkit, CoquiSourceToolkit, ToolkitGeneratorToolkit, SkillToolkit, auto-discovered toolkits) and all standalone tools (spawn_agent, credentials, package_info, php_execute, vision_analyze, restart_coqui, config, summarize_conversation, extract_memories, toolkit_list). Shell is open by default (empty allowlist — all commands permitted); agents.defaults.shellAllowedCommands enables opt-in restrictive mode; agents.defaults.allowSudo (default false) controls sudo access; allowSudo/allowedCommands are passed to SpawnAgentTool for child agents. Memory is SQLite-backed via MemoryStore with FTS5 full-text search and optional vector embeddings; core memory summary is auto-injected into instructions(). Resolves a ContextWindow from ModelDefinition at construction time and passes it to AbstractAgent for per-iteration token budget enforcement. Budget gate respects explicit Eager/Deferred overrides from ToolkitLoadingRegistry, uses percentage-based promotion for Auto candidates. Also builds prompt-section telemetry with pinned-versus-deferrable classification and rationale for budget inspection surfaces. Constructed fresh on every REPL turn.

files.description: Handles agent creation, execution, and turn message persistence. Manages the full turn lifecycle: creates a turn record before execution, tracks timing, extracts tool usage and child agent counts, and completes the turn with all metadata after execution. Includes autoSummarizeIfNeeded() for pre-turn budget checks with workflow context injection, and autoExtractMemories() which runs LLM-based memory extraction after each successful turn (configurable via agents.defaults.memory.autoExtract). Also builds prompt-preview and prompt-budget snapshots used by the REPL and API inspection surfaces, including prompt-section rationale and pinning metadata. Accepts optional TodoStore and ArtifactStore to build workflow context for summarization.

files.description: Coordinates the autonomous quality loop across schedules and background tasks. Bootstraps default evaluator and learner schedules when enabled, and queues learner follow-up background tasks when poor evaluations are saved. When an EvaluationStore is injected, it also persists explicit provenance from the evaluation record to the learner follow-up task instead of relying on inferred title matching. Learner follow-up tasks now also receive typed LearnerFollowUpMetadata on the background task record. files.description: Lightweight tool resolver and executor for background tool tasks. Builds the same toolkits as OrchestratorAgent (filesystem, shell, memory, project source, PHP execute, discovered packages) but without creating an agent or involving an LLM. Shell is open by default — resolveShellAllowedCommands() returns an empty array unless agents.defaults.shellAllowedCommands is configured; resolveShellDeniedCommands() returns ['sudo'] unless allowSudo is true. Finds a tool by name from the collected toolkit tools and calls execute() directly. Used by TaskRunCommand when a task record has tool_name set.

files.description: ReactPHP Fiber-based concurrent tool executor. Implements BatchToolExecutorInterface to enable parallel tool execution when multiple tool calls are returned by the LLM. Uses React\Async\parallel() to run each tool in its own Fiber — concurrency occurs during I/O suspension (HTTP requests, async network calls). Shell tools use blocking calls and do not benefit from Fiber concurrency. Single tool calls bypass Fiber overhead. TerminationException propagates correctly via parallel() rejection. Result ordering is preserved via ksort().
methods: execute(ToolInterface $tool, array $arguments): ToolResult — single tool pass-through execution
executeBatch(array $batch): array — concurrent execution via React\Async\parallel(), returns ToolResult[] in original order

files.description: Single-shot LLM evaluator for goal_bound loop termination. Sends the loop goal, optional evaluation prompt, and the latest stage output to a utility model and parses a structured ACHIEVED/NOT_ACHIEVED judgment. Follows the TitleGenerator pattern — one LLM call, no tool use, catches all errors. Falls back to not-achieved on any failure.

files.description: Direct tool execution evaluator for tool_bound loop termination. Delegates tool resolution and execution to BackgroundToolExecutor, parses numeric output, and compares against a threshold using the configured operator. No LLM involved — zero token cost. Valid operators: >=, >, <=, <, ==, !=.
methods: evaluate(string $toolName, array $arguments, string $operator, float $threshold): ToolBoundEvaluationResult — execute tool and compare numeric output

files.description: Core loop orchestration engine. Drives entire loop lifecycle (start, stage preparation, completion, iteration evaluation, advancement). Supports project resolution in startLoop via 3-tier fallback: explicit project_id/slug → active session project → auto-create. Creates sprints with auto-transitions. Snapshots definitions, evaluates termination conditions (evaluation_bound, iteration_bound, time_bound, goal_bound, tool_bound). Supports template parameters with {{placeholder}} substitution. Enforces inter-stage artifact contracts via requires_artifact_from and explicit evidence verification via requires_explicit_evidence — queries ArtifactStore by session+createdAfter (optionally narrowing by projectId when available), never silently bypasses when projectId is null. Injects Required Deliverables into coder prompts when next stage requires explicit evidence. Injects Evidence Artifacts section into reviewer prompts with explicit artifact IDs, titles, and types for deterministic discovery. Injects rich project context into stage prompts. Prepared stages now carry typed LoopStageHandoffMetadata for persistence and observability. Does not execute child agents directly — LoopManager handles execution via background tasks.

files.description: Diagnostic 'doctor' command that checks 10 health categories: PHP environment (version, extensions, memory, putenv), config (openclaw.json validity, primary model, roles), workspace (directory, writable, composer.json, autoloader), database (existence, connection, tables, stats, message integrity with per-session UTF-8 scan), credentials (.env existence, permissions), providers (Ollama connectivity + model listing, cloud API key presence), toolkits (installed.json validity, class autoloadability), skills (directory, SKILL.md presence), launcher (bin/coqui-launcher executable), and disk space. Supports --repair flag to auto-fix issues (create missing dirs, init composer.json, fix .env permissions, repair malformed UTF-8 in messages, delete unfixable rows). Supports --json for machine-readable output.
